purpose: Make the three key-area proposals reviewable as a crosswalk from provisional geometry to the state station, public anchor, spatial response, scenario zone, scene passports, acceptance contract, and evidence still required before G1.

authority_boundary.rule: Every area-to-node relationship below is a conceptual design mapping. It does not establish an official boundary, exact site, owner consent, approval, built condition, operating result, or partner commitment.

records.name_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区

spatial_response.zh: 一园、一栈、两界面：低风险环境共测、可验证模型公共栈、公众观察与申诉、人工接管与维护界面。
spatial_response.en: One garden, one verification stack, and two interfaces: low-risk environmental co-testing, a verifiable-model commons, public observation and appeal, plus staffed takeover and maintenance.

modes.activation: test loop and automated equipment remain off
modes.protected_baseline: non-AI public observation path and unobstructed green-space use

modes.activation: equipment remains on the service edge and the public stays outside the loop
modes.restore: remove equipment and temporary enclosure; return the path and green space

modes.activation: only after every required-before-G1 item is evidenced
modes.stop_and_restore: collision, boundary breach, or failed physical stop triggers isolation and staffed restoration

modes.activation: automation, network, sound, and light stop
modes.restart: only after an independent retest; staffed explanation and detour remain

required_before_g1: official or owner-confirmed site geometry and access conditions
named accountable test-site and on-site safety roles
legal site, safety, fire, network, data and emergency-stop review
fixed non-AI baseline and bounded data specification
community observation/appeal route and independent retest package
unknowns: railway, road, ecology and heritage controls
measured public value or recovery performance
no_claims: not an official key-area polygon or engineering site
not an approved AI test field or partner commitment
not a field-tested safety, energy, incident or archive result

records.name_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区

spatial_response.zh: 一街、两院、四节点：开源发布街、问题拆解与团队匹配、公共评议、未成年人教育和无屏讨论。
spatial_response.en: One street, two courtyards, and four nodes: an open-source street, problem decomposition and team matching, public review, youth learning, and screen-free discussion.

modes.activation: matching and recommendation layers remain off
modes.protected_baseline: free passage and screen-free public seating

modes.activation: booked kit stays outside the through-route and no account is required
modes.restore: remove kit and temporary signs; return both courts to ordinary use

modes.activation: only after safeguarding, consent, withdrawal, accountable roles, and non-technical access are evidenced
modes.stop_and_restore: withdrawal, safeguarding, or material group-gap trigger stops matching and supports staffed exit

modes.activation: amplification, screens, collection, and automated matching stop
modes.restart: paper information and a staffed point remain; reopen only after review

required_before_g1: official or venue-confirmed site, safeguarding and access conditions
source, copyright, generated-content, consent and withdrawal review
equal technical, non-technical and non-AI participation route
independent provenance, inclusion and correction retest package
unknowns: exact venue, parcel and operating hours
participant cohort, consent and withdrawal performance
rights status of content, code and generated media
no_claims: not an official Origin Community boundary or venue inventory
not an accepted community, school, rights-holder or partner commitment
not a field-tested learning, matching, cultural or accessibility result

records.name_zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业聚集区

spatial_response.zh: 四象限步行 + 一厅一台：钟轨会客厅、城市服务台、发布界面、人工窗口、无屏默认区和静音时段。
spatial_response.en: Four-quadrant walking plus one commons and one desk: a rail commons, staffed city-services desk, publication frontage, screen-free default, and quiet hours.

modes.protected_baseline: four-way walking, physical wayfinding, quiet rest, and staffed service

modes.activation: release activity yields to commuting, screen-free rest, and staffed tasks
modes.restore: close displays and remove event kit; restore ordinary flow

modes.activation: only after route and service ownership, accessibility, source maintenance, staffed fallback, and accountable roles are evidenced
modes.stop_and_restore: expiry, source conflict, or failed handoff takes the answer path offline and routes users to official non-AI or staffed service

modes.activation: automated answers, sound, and light stop
modes.restart: correct the source and complete the full retest; restart only with accountable-owner approval

required_before_g1: official or owner-confirmed route, venue and service-source conditions
named public-service, staffed-counter and operations roles
transport, fire, privacy, accessibility and source-maintenance review
same-task AI, staffed and non-AI comparison with formal-error stop rule
independent stale-source, handoff, route and group-parity retest package
unknowns: exact station-area route, venue and service owner
current barrier, facility and accessibility conditions

traffic, railway, heritage, fire and municipal controls

no_claims: not an approved parcel, public-service desk or delivery location
not evidence of an existing partner, budget or government mandate

twin_track_frontend_contract.purpose: 把双轨京张作为前台空间总纲，把 JZ-AIOS、G0—G3、证据门和权利边界保留为后台治理内核；该合同只表达空间语法和公众可读旅程，不增加场景、边界或建设承诺。
twin_track_frontend_contract.purpose_en: Make Twin-track Jing-Zhang the front-stage spatial master plan while retaining JZ-AIOS, G0–G3, evidence gates, and rights boundaries as the back-stage governance kernel. This contract expresses spatial syntax and a readable public journey only; it adds no scene, boundary, or construction commitment.

daily_track.continuity: continuous ordinary public life; no proof equipment or account gate
daily_track.entry_rule: anyone may enter, pause, ask, leave, or continue without registration, QR code, or AI

proof_track.continuity: intermittent, time-bounded, localized, and removable; never a continuous occupied strip
proof_track.activation: voluntary public learning or future-approved bounded test only after the relevant G1 evidence contract is complete
proof_track.protected_path: daily track remains open and the non-AI comparator remains available
proof_track.stop_rule: any public harm, boundary breach, failed human handoff, stale source, or material rights/safeguarding gap stops the proof overlay

switchyards.role_zh: 把公共问题接入共创、共学和公共评议；连续日常街先于任何验证叠层。
switchyards.role_en: Receives public problems into co-creation, learning, and public review; the continuous daily street comes before any proof overlay.

switchyards.role_zh: 把已提出的问题转为离线、低风险、可停止的验证；公众观察边、人工接管和急停边不可被占用。
switchyards.role_en: Turns a submitted problem into offline, low-risk, stoppable verification; the public observation edge, staffed takeover, and physical-stop edge remain protected.

switchyards.role_zh: 把通过、失败和修正变成可读的公共发布与人工服务；通勤、静音休憩和来源纠错优先。
switchyards.role_en: Makes passed, failed, and corrected evidence readable through public release and staffed service; commuting, quiet rest, and source correction take priority.

failure_siding.spatial_role: temporary isolation, staffed explanation, detour, correction, and return to the daily track
failure_siding.restart_rule: no proof overlay restarts until the declared stop condition, accountable handoff, corrected source, and independent retest are closed

six_city_signals.public_question: 这里是日常、验证还是停止？
six_city_signals.public_question_en: Is this daily, proof, or stopped?

six_city_signals.public_question: 这条信息从哪里来、何时更新？
six_city_signals.public_question_en: Where did this come from and when was it updated?
How do I stop, detour, and recover?

civic_timetable.rule_zh: 连续日常轨开放；人工、无屏和非 AI 路径可用。
civic_timetable.rule_en: The daily track is open; staffed, screen-free, and non-AI paths remain available.

civic_timetable.rule_zh: 静音、低照度、无屏优先；不以活动或验证占用普通生活。
civic_timetable.rule_en: Quiet, low-light, screen-free use takes priority; ordinary life is not displaced by events or proof.

civic_timetable.rule_zh: 验证轨只在公告、批准和有责任人的时段出现，不形成连续占地。
civic_timetable.rule_en: The proof track appears only in announced, approved, accountable windows and never becomes a continuous occupied strip.

civic_timetable.window: any time a stop condition is declared
civic_timetable.rule_zh: 停止→人工解释→失败侧线→恢复日常；公众无需等待系统或注册。
civic_timetable.rule_en: Stop → staffed explanation → failure siding → return to daily use; the public need not wait for a system or register.

typical_section.section_rule: daily track is continuous; proof overlay is intermittent; staffed station, screen-free node, and recovery garden are distinct spatial roles
typical_section.section_rule_zh: 日常轨连续；验证叠层间歇；人工站房、无屏节点和恢复花园是不同空间角色。

readable_journey.action_zh: 从既有入口进入，沿连续日常轨步行、通勤、休憩或办事。
readable_journey.action_en: Enter from an existing access and walk, commute, rest, or use a service along the continuous daily track.

readable_journey.action_zh: 通过入口、时段、状态、人工、来源、退出六类信号判断是否继续；不注册、不扫码也能完成基本任务。
readable_journey.action_en: Read the six signals—entry, time, state, human, source, and exit; the basic task works without registration, a QR code, or AI.

readable_journey.action_zh: 只有自愿进入公告的验证窗口，才经换轨场接入间歇验证轨；日常轨和非 AI 对照仍在旁侧。
readable_journey.action_en: Only a voluntary, announced proof window uses a switchyard to enter the intermittent proof track; the daily track and non-AI comparator remain beside it.

readable_journey.action_zh: 任何人都可以说停、找人工、绕行、离开或申诉；失败侧线隔离验证叠层，不把故障变成日常阻断。
readable_journey.action_en: Anyone may stop, ask a person, detour, leave, or appeal; the failure siding isolates the proof overlay instead of blocking daily life.

readable_journey.action_zh: 修正来源、完成责任交接和独立复测后，才撤除侧线并恢复普通状态；否则保持 G0/退出。
readable_journey.action_en: Only after source correction, accountable handoff, and independent retest does the siding close and ordinary use return; otherwise remain G0 or exit.

backend_governance_kernel.rights_boundary: not_fully_cleared; repository review only; public or professional reuse remains blocked or confirmation-dependent
backend_governance_kernel.current_state: all scenes remain G0; approvals, field audits, test executions, and known operating results remain 0 or unknown

check each crosswalk ID against the referenced file
treat spatial response and interface links as conceptual mappings
replace provisional geometry and unknowns only with organizer or qualified-owner evidence
re-run geometry, metrics, drawings, HTML, self-check and manifest after replacement
review_protocol.coverage_definition: The ratio measures presence of required crosswalk fields in the three records; it is not field coverage, partner confirmation, approval, operating performance, or public-value evidence.
